comment: Eval case set (data, not code; eval.py loads this). Images are fixture ids, never paths: private photos resolve from eval/fixtures/ or the EVAL_* settings (docs/evaluation.md), gen-* fixtures are built deterministically by eval/make_fixtures.py. Grounding entries are regexes matched case-insensitively against the reply; for image cases they quote text the fixture draws.

cases.idea: a paper boat drifts down a rain gutter into a puddle
a street food chef in Bangkok flips noodles in a flaming wok and tells the camera 'This is how my grandmother did it.'
the two people on the right side of the photo have a Jedi lightsaber fight in this parking lot
everyone cheers and the man on the far right jumps for joy
the Team Pizza crew from the first photo rides horses into the ranch from the second photo at sunset, and the wranglers lasso the man in the cap
the three women let go of the rope and the man in the middle spins free, then tips his hat
a toy steam train chugs over a wooden bridge, puffs white steam and blows its whistle as it rolls down the other side
the sign flickers to life, confetti bursts over the blue square and the yellow circle, and the whole poster hums with celebration
a barista lifts the brown mug from the photo, pours latte art into it and slides it along the cafe counter
the TEAM PIZZA crew drives up to the RESTON RANCH gate, stacks pizza boxes on the fence and hands one across to the rancher
